summary: UNILEVER PLC filed a Form 6-K to disclose its voting rights and capital position as of April 30, 2026, in accordance with UK disclosure rules. The filing reports 2,185,205,247 ordinary shares issued, with no treasury shares and 253,651 shares held by group companies (with non-exercisable voting rights), resulting in 2,184,951,596 voting shares. This routine capital update provides a denominator for shareholder notifications, contains no transaction, tender, or special event. It is a periodic regulatory disclosure without deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural changes. No special situation is present.
